other_conditions: Applicant must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965
The applicant’s contribution towards the labour welfare fund must be regularly received by the Board
A disability certificate issued by the competent authority is required
The applicant must have been a member of the Board for at least 6 months before applying
The benefit is available to disabled registered construction workers and their dependents
benefits_summary: One‑time supply of a tri‑cycle to a disabled construction worker or their dependent.
documents_required: Disability certificate issued by competent authority
Clear picture of both sides of Aadhaar card
Clear pictures of all pages of the BOCW copy issued by the Board
